terms.gloss: eucalyptus: the botanists’ name of the genus
evidence: L’Hér. Sert. Angl. 18 (1789): Eucalyptus (Australian Plant Name Index; Plants of the World Online)
terms.comment: The genus name L’Héritier gave the tree in 1789, a Greek compound of εὖ, well, and καλυπτός, covered, used here as a word. The tree is Australian, was unknown to the ancients, and is not in Lewis & Short; Traupman, Morgan–Owens, Levi–Bini, and Andresian have no word for it. Feminine, as tree names are and as botanists treat it (Eucalyptus obliqua, the type species).

sources: Australian Plant Name Index: s.v. Eucalyptus L’Hér.
